title: The 5 Deepest Ocean Trenches, Ranked (#1 Swallows Mount Everest)

scenes.text: The five deepest places in the ocean, ranked. Number one is deeper than Mount Everest is tall.

scenes.label: Kermadec · ~10,040 m
scenes.text: Number five: the Kermadec Trench in the South Pacific. About ten thousand meters down, and the shallowest on this list.

scenes.label: Kuril-Kamchatka · 10,500 m
scenes.text: Number four: the Kuril-Kamchatka Trench in the Pacific. About ten thousand five hundred meters of dark water.

scenes.label: Philippine · 10,540 m
scenes.text: Number three: the Philippine Trench. Its deepest spot, the Galathea Depth, is about ten thousand five hundred and forty meters down.

scenes.label: Tonga · 10,882 m
scenes.text: Number two: the Tonga Trench. Its Horizon Deep is about ten thousand eight hundred and eighty-two meters. Almost the record, but not quite.

scenes.label: Challenger Deep · ~10,900 m
scenes.text: Number one: Challenger Deep in the Mariana Trench. About ten thousand nine hundred meters. Mount Everest would sit two thousand meters underwater.

description:
The five deepest ocean trenches, ranked by maximum depth.
The Mariana Trench's Challenger Deep is so deep that Mount Everest would sit about two thousand meters below the surface.
Would you ever dive that deep?
first_comment: Would you dive to the bottom of the Mariana Trench? And what should we rank next?
